notes: Not a formal LGD list/gazette, so trust 4. The portal has no pourashava list, no union list and no downloadable Excel/PDF directory; its menu pages for city corporations, pourashavas, zila parishads and upazila parishads return HTTP 404 (see raw/menu_page_status.txt). Only the upazila-parishad list (updated 2023-05-31) and a national union-parishad total (4571, updated 2023-05-15) exist.
